properties.displayName: UAV S38 - Maintenance Implant (Component Replace + Hash Mismatch within 30min)
properties.description: 정비 임플란트 탐지 — UAVMaintenance_CL의 component_replace 이벤트 후 30분 이내 UAVPgse_CL에서 HashMatch==0(false) 또는 SbomForbiddenCount>0 발생 시 정비 절차를 악용한 하드웨어/펌웨어 임플란트 삽입으로 판단. 실제 컬럼: HashMatch는 SByte(0=false,1=true). MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0864 Transient Cyber Asset
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 2h;
let Maintenance =
    UAVMaintenance_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where EventType == 'component_replace'
    | project T1=TimeGenerated, UAVId, ComponentName, Operator;
let PgseViolation =
    UAVPgse_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where HashMatch == 0 or SbomForbiddenCount > 0
    | project T2=TimeGenerated, UAVId, HashMatch, SbomForbiddenCount, FailReason;
Maintenance
| join kind=inner (PgseViolation) on UAVId
| where T2 >= T1 and T2 <= T1 + 30m
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    HashMatch == 0 and SbomForbiddenCount > 0, strcat("정비후_해시불일치_금지SBOM_동시_", ComponentName),
    HashMatch == 0, strcat("정비후_펌웨어_해시불일치_", ComponentName),
    strcat("정비후_금지SBOM_", ComponentName))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project T1, T2, UAVId, ComponentName, Operator, HashMatch, SbomForbiddenCount, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by T1 desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S38 - Maintenance Implant (Component Replace + Hash Mismatch within 30min) - {{Operator}}
